note: Reel 30: How Sure Are You? Script v1, before the script review. The narrator is the series voice (af_heart); the officer is cast from the audition. Facts: docs/research.md.
ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: This time, he's one of these six.
Whoever you pick goes to prison.
How sure are you? Out of ten.
The magistrate says nothing, and the police have to wait outside.
He says that to every number.
He's a drawing, so he can't see what you picked.
But you felt surer, didn't you?
Some of you are right. All of you feel right.
Now you'd swear you were sure from the start, and nobody wrote down that you weren't.
In nineteen eighty-four, a real witness heard something like that, and thought, Bingo. I did it right.
She'd picked an innocent man. Ronald Cotton lost more than ten years.
lines.text_kokoro: She'd picked an innocent man. Ronald [Cotton](/kˈɑːtən/) lost more than ten years.

lines.text: I wasn't lying, though. He really is one of these six.
